_comment: Which look is active. The styles are in config\styles\<name>.json. After a switch: scripts\Install-Style.ps1. Description: docs\style.md.
_install: Shared by all styles, so a switch replaces the same entries instead of adding new ones: the profile in Windows Terminal (fixed GUID), the variable by which the status line recognises a local session, and the ending of the backup copies of the state before the first style (the German name stays so earlier backups are still found).
_former: Names of styles and Claude Code theme files from earlier versions (German names until 2026-11). Install-Style.ps1 takes their entries out of Windows Terminal and Claude Code like those of the current styles.
